fieldNotes.truckGate: Legacy urban plant. The SE truck-dock court is open access off a side street - Street View (2025-07) shows trucks/trailers parked at dock doors with no barrier arm or gate at the public road. Main bakery is perimeter-fenced along NE Columbia Blvd, but the active truck-dock court has open driveway access. Called false (open driveway, no road-side control); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small square roofed structure sits internally near the dock court (~45.5808,-122.6634) - possibly a booth or covered checkpoint, but it is not positioned at a road-side gate. No clear staffed booth at a controlled truck entrance; called false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Tight urban site; the dock court connects almost directly to the side street with minimal stacking depth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Truck dock doors on the SE dock building with several trucks/trailers backed in (Street View + z20 imagery); estimate ~18, banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked at the dock building and a green-trailer lot just SE across NE Columbia Blvd that may be associated trailer storage; estimate 10-25, low confidence on count.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Rail receiving (flour silos / rail siding) on the south building face is physically separate from the SE truck-dock cluster.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail siding runs to flour silos on the south building face off the adjacent main-line corridor (z19 imagery at 45.5798,-122.664 and 45.5805,-122.666) - the plant is rail-served for ingredients.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple connected/adjacent building masses: the main bakery, the SE dock building, and ancillary structures.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left low-confidence.
